scraped.scraped_description: Social media as it should be. Find your community among millions of users, unleash your creativity, and have some fun again.

name: Bluesky
tagline: Open social media platform built on the AT Protocol
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Competitive pressure from established social platforms
academic_citations: Bluesky and the AT Protocol: Decentralizing Social Media (2024)
Platform Governance and User Agency in Decentralized Networks (2024)
published_performance_metrics: User growth metrics published quarterly; moderation statistics available in transparency reports
documented_limitations: Early-stage platform with smaller user base than competitors
Limited third-party app ecosystem at launch
curation_criteria: Community-driven moderation with algorithmic feed customization; open-source moderation services
contributor_governance: Open contribution model for AT Protocol; community input on platform features through GitHub discussions
community_ownership: Limited; platform controlled by Bluesky PBC with community input mechanisms
controversies: Debate over decentralization claims vs. centralized control
political_bias_allegations: Allegations of left-leaning user base and moderation bias from conservative users (2023-2024)
legal_regulatory_issues: Subject to EU Digital Services Act compliance; ongoing regulatory scrutiny of content moderation practices
ai_involvement: Machine learning used for content recommendation and moderation assistance; algorithmic feed personalization
